text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф blows the competition
away and
takes first place. Her
performance bodes well for
the Satsuki
Sho, although it seems to have

intimidated the general manager.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, Симболи Рудольф
encounters
Марузенски, the "Beast."
Much like Rudolf,
Марузенски's
formidable skills have made her the
talk
of the racing world.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Could this potential rivalry bring out a
new side
of Симболи Рудольф? I can't help
but wonder what
the future might hold.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
